abstract:
BACKGROUND: Patients with advanced pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (aPDAC) often experience general health decline at diagnosis due to a high symptom burden. The optimal management of symptoms and/or poor ECOG performance status (PS) in these patients remains an unmet medical need.
PATIENTS AND METHODS: In this multicenter study, patients with PS ≥2 and pathologically confirmed or imaging-suspected aPDAC were enrolled at their first oncology visit in a personalized 14-day emergency integrative supportive care program (14-EISCP) to manage pain, nutrition, diagnostics, and stenting procedures. The primary endpoint was 14-EISCP success, defined as the feasibility of planned procedures and clinical benefit, including post-EISCP PS ≤1; ≥5-point improvement in fatigue, pain, or global health-related quality-of-life (HRQoL) scores (EORTC QLQ-C15-PAL); or chemotherapy initiation within 30 days.
RESULTS: A total of 106 patients were included, of whom 93 were evaluable for the primary endpoint analysis (median age, 76 years [range, 68-80]; PS 3, 20.9%; metastases, 61.3%). Median overall survival was 4.1 months (95% CI, 2.6-5.6). 14-EISCP was successful in 59.1% (n=55) of patients, meeting the primary objective of clinical benefit, and feasibility was achieved in 70.9% of patients. Post-EISCP clinical benefit was observed in 79.6% of patients, with PS improvement to 0/1 in 13.2%, HRQoL improvement in 23.9%, and chemotherapy initiation ≤30 days in 73.1%. Among evaluable patients, 17.2% received mFOLFIRINOX or gemcitabine + nab-paclitaxel, 35.4% received FOLFOX, 25.3% received gemcitabine or 5-FU alone, and 22.2% received best supportive care. In patients with PS 2 at baseline, the administration of doublet/triplet chemotherapy was associated with improved overall survival compared with single-agent chemotherapy.
CONCLUSIONS: These results offer a promising framework for improving outcomes in patients with aPDAC, bridging the gap between symptom management and systemic therapy administration. In patients with PS ≥2 and aPDAC, the personalized 14-EISCP was feasible and provided meaningful clinical benefit, allowing doublet or triplet chemotherapy in approximately half of the patients.
CLINICALTRIALS: gov identifier: NCT02979483.
key_points_ko: 14일 긴급 통합 지지요법 프로그램(14-EISCP)의 임상적 이점 달성 성공률은 59.1%였습니다.
프로그램을 마친 환자의 73.1%가 30일 이내에 항암 화학요법을 시작했습니다.
초기 수행능력 점수 2점 환자 중 2제 또는 3제 병용 항암제 치료를 받은 환자는 단일 항암제 치료군보다 생존기간이 길었습니다.
summary_ko: 전신 상태가 저하된(ECOG 수행능력 점수 2 이상) 진행성 췌장암 환자를 대상으로 14일간 개인 맞춤형 긴급 통합 지지요법 프로그램(14-EISCP)을 적용한 연구입니다. 통증 관리, 영양 공급, 스텐트 시술 등을 시행하여 환자의 59.1%에서 임상적 이점이 나타났습니다. 지지요법 이후 환자의 73.1%가 30일 이내에 항암 화학요법을 시작할 수 있었습니다. 이 프로그램은 상태가 좋지 않은 환자가 항암 치료를 받을 수 있도록 돕는 실용적인 프레임워크를 제공합니다.
title: Emergency Integrative Supportive Care Program for Frail Patients With Advanced Pancreatic Cancer: A Prospective GERCOR ARCAD Study
title_ko: 쇠약한 진행성 췌장암 환자를 위한 긴급 통합 지지요법 프로그램: 전향적 GERCOR ARCAD 연구
